text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While walking around town on my day
off, I
happen to see Yamanin Zephyr
leaving a
restaurant.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I did. I had a delicious meal with a
variety of side
dishes, and now I'm
perfectly full.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Next up, I'm going to a European salad
bar.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The breeze blowing in through the
window this
morning was so inviting that
I got up bright and
early, and have been
out and about since.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Then, the light noon breeze reminded
me that I
had yet to eat at all.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And at that moment, I realized I was
starving. So,
I have to make up for
missing breakfast.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr

...Yes, you're right. Maybe my hunger

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
An overly strong wind will strew things
all over
the place. I should ensure that I
don't end up a
source of disorder myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr heads to the salad bar
and eats
a reasonable amount of food.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. They have all sorts of vegetables,
so I'm in
for quite the feast.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm off to fill my stomach right up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr heads off to the salad
bar and
savors every kind of vegetable
on offer.
